sources_considered.why: Primary bargaining comparison explicitly records the parties' May 1 positions.
Contemporaneous AMPTP statement, hosted by a news organization; supplies the employers' explanation.
Contemporaneous reporting places the AI dispute among the strike issues. Used for corroboration, not to establish private motives.

evidence_items.locator: Page 6, ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE row, AMPTP OFFERS (as of 5/1/2023) column
evidence_items.explanation: The table records rejection of restrictions on AI writing, rewriting, source material and training. This supports the existence of a substantive dispute, but does not establish the employers' motive.

evidence_items.publisher: Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers
evidence_items.explanation: The AMPTP presented unresolved creative and legal questions, including writers' own possible use of AI, as its explanation. That alternative account limits an inference about executive motives, although it does not disprove Zitron's account.

evidence_items.locator: Section A Pivotal Moment, opening paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: Contemporaneous reporting corroborates AI as one part of the dispute. It does not establish that the specific executive intention attributed by Zitron caused the strike.

unresolved_gaps: No examined record establishes the attributed executive motive independently of the refusal to accept restrictions.
The evidence establishes an AI dispute more clearly than the full causal explanation.
